scripts.sync-public: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const path=require('path');const src=path.resolve('../client/public');const dst=path.resolve('./public');if(fs.existsSync(src)){fs.cpSync(src,dst,{recursive:true,force:true});console.log('[sync-public] copied',src,'->',dst);}else{console.warn('[sync-public] source not found:',src);}"
